title: equisetum pratense f. nanum
intro: Equisetum pratense f. nanum, commonly known as Dwarf Scouring Rush or Dwarf Horsetail, is a small, perennial plant belonging to the Equisetaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include the treatment of urinary tract infections, kidney stones, and other kidney-related issues due to its diuretic and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Equisetum pratense f. nanum include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects, making it a promising natural remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
